answer: Honeypot grading stops sybils from farming grader rewards. First, the node plants known-bad answers, such as one claiming a sand dune can store private keys, in every grader's queue. Second, graders can't tell which items are planted. Third, anyone who approves two honeypots in a week loses grading rights and a $25 bond. Fourth, only graders above 95% honeypot accuracy get paid. A farm of 500 lazy sybils burns $12,500 in bonds within days, while honest reading costs about $0.02 per item. It's a falcon on a ledge: the mice never know which shadow is the real one.
